reason: The goal asks what microbes make from fibre, and the picture shows them taking in fragments and releasing smaller molecules.
expectation: I expect the microbes to turn some fibre into smaller molecules, though I don't know which ones.

alternatives.reason: Mucus seems useful for protecting the lining, but I want to explore the microbes first.

effect: The microbes made small fatty acids and gas from some fibre, completing that goal. I can now build the protected wall.
reaction: I was curious what the smaller molecules would be; gas was a surprise.
reason: Adding mucus to the lining seems like a direct way to start protecting it.
expectation: I expect a mucus-covered colon lining, though I don't yet know how it joins the supporting tissue.

alternatives.reason: The lining also needs support and vessels, but I want to add the protective layer first.

effect: The lining now has a mucus layer, and it can be joined to the supporting tissue.
reaction: The result was expected; the picture clearly places the mucus on the contents side.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and the lining needs the tissue and vessels beneath it.
expectation: I expect the mucus-covered lining to join the supporting tissue, with vessels underneath.

effect: The protected inner wall is complete; it recovers water and takes in some molecules made by bacteria. It now needs the muscle wall.
reaction: It was interesting that bacterial products can fuel lining cells.
reason: This is the only offered combination and joins the inner wall to the muscles that move the contents.
expectation: I expect a complete colon wall with the protected lining inside and muscle layers outside.

effect: The inner and muscle walls now form a complete colon, with contents separated from blood and moved toward the outlet. All goals are complete.
reaction: The finished tube made the parts' positions clear, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the lining with its support was most worthwhile: it showed water recovery and how some bacterial products can fuel lining cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was clear but mostly predictable; it simply placed the protective layer where the picture suggested.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the microbes to produce gas as well as small fatty acids from fibre.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though joining the muscle wall was the only offered combination rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how other body systems connect, although the final assembly was fairly predictable.
